name: IYO Kaiseki
lunchNote: Bento box · Wed–Fri (kaiseki menu €180 every lunch, ordered by 2pm)
lunchNoteIt: Bento box · mer–ven (menu kaiseki €180 a ogni pranzo, ordinabile entro le 14)

menus.name: Kaiseki tasting menu
menus.note: Lunch (ordered by 2pm) or dinner (by 9:30pm), for the whole table and by reservation only; drinks pairing €120; A4 wagyu sirloin can be added for €40

menus.name: bento box
menus.note: Lunch Wednesday to Friday only, not on public holidays; sashimi, sushi or kobachi bento with tempura, a grilled dish, pickles, rice, miso soup and ice cream

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, by phone, by WhatsApp (+39 349 973 8376) or by email (info@iyo-kaiseki.com).
cancellation: Bookings can be changed or cancelled free of charge until 3pm the day before. Later cancellations and no-shows are charged €100 per person.
dressCode: Elegant casual. Guests are asked not to wear strong perfume, scented creams or deodorant, as they interfere with the menu.
children: Not recommended for children under 10; exceptions can be discussed with the restaurant in advance.
